entities.name: Trypillia (Cucuteni-Trypillia) Culture
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: One of Europe's earliest civilisations: massive proto-urban settlements (Talianki — 15,000 inhabitants), sophisticated pottery, agriculture, and the mysterious ritual burning of settlements. A foundational element of Ukrainian identity.
